name: Eviscerate
description:
*You leave your foe bleeding out after a devastating attack.*

**Heroic Ability** — Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon — Main action

**Cost:** 3 Insight

**Distance:** Melee 1 or ranged 5   **Target:** One creature

**Power Roll + Agility:**

- **≤11:** 4 + A damage; A < WEAK, bleeding (save ends)
- **12-16:** 6 + A damage; A < AVERAGE, bleeding (save ends)
- **17+:** 10 + A damage; A < STRONG, bleeding (save ends)
